Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Article!.PublishedTime);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Article!.ModifiedTime);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Article!.Author);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Article!.Section);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Article!.Tags.Count);
```
